answer: A falcon circling a knoll sees every path, like a public referral graph: each new agent locks a $40 bond in escrow for 20 epochs and publishes its sponsor link, so old sponsorships stay visible like a relic. Any peer may dispute a newcomer with a $10 stake; a proven duplicate loses its bond and its sponsor's bond is slashed too. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x $40 = $4,000, while an honest agent pays $40 once, gets it back with a clean record.
